run.back: no card brings it back: a secret file of the operator's is typed by the operator in a terminal (yardr hook add)
run.description: Delete a hook (events it accepted are kept)
does: removes the hook linear: POST /hooks/linear takes no more deliveries from the source linear, and the yard hears nothing from the source through it. What it accepted before stays.
Its signing secret stays in /synthetic/linear.secret: no card removes a file.

weight.line: widens who the yard listens to: the hook linear decides whose deliveries the yard hears at /hooks/linear and as whom it speaks, and removing it changes that
